caption: The drawing depicts a weather vane or ornamental ironwork object rendered in shades of black and gray on a light, off-white background. The central element is a vertical pole intersected by a horizontal bar, both featuring a textured, hammered appearance. At the top of the pole, a stylized flag or banner, ending in a pointed tip and featuring cut-out sections, is attached, with the number "1744" inscribed on it. Attached to the intersection of the vertical and horizontal bars is a decorative flourish of wrought iron, forming symmetrical, curving patterns reminiscent of leaves and vines. There are several pointed, leaf-like elements attached at regular intervals, both vertically and horizontally, enhancing the organic motif. The artist's signature, "ED. J. SaLzLEIDER," is present in small, gray letters near the lower right part of the drawing. The composition is balanced and centered on the page, with no additional objects or background elements.
title: Weather Vane
